000018.SZ.name: 神城A退 (神州长城股份有限公司)
000018.SZ.current_semantic: valid through delist_date (inclusive); blocked on trade_date > delist_date
000018.SZ.semantic_note: Announcement 2020-007 confirms delisting on 2020-01-07, which is the first day the instrument is no longer valid. The current inclusive convention instead treats delist_date as still valid and only blocks from 2020-01-08. Date semantics are pending migration in a later phase; the current engine is retained as a reference baseline and no per-stock exception is hardcoded.
000018.SZ.fact_at_signal_2020_01_03: The termination decision (2019-11-15) and the delisting-arrangement schedule (start 2019-11-25, expected last trading day 2020-01-06) were already public before the 2020-01-03 weekly signal.
000018.SZ.buy_2020_01_06_stage: The 2020-01-03 signal executes at the 2020-01-06 close, which is the confirmed last trading day of the delisting arrangement period.
000018.SZ.publication_precision: Both announcements carry a dated signature (2019-11-15 and 2020-01-06); no intraday disclosure timestamp is available.
